name: Gear Gang Boss (CR 12)
body:
Gear Gang Boss
CR 12

XP 19,200
Auttaine gunslinger 5/rogue 8
N Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +5; Senses Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+3 armor, +2 deflection, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural)
hp 93 (13 HD; 8d8+5d10+26)
Fort +8, Ref +13, Will +3; +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.

Defensive Abilities evasion, improved uncanny dodge, nimble +1, trap sense +2; Resist construct resistance

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk rapier +15/+10/+5 (1d6+3/18–20)
Ranged +1 zero pistol +16/+11/+6 (1d8+4 cold/x4) or mwk double-barreled shotgun +15 (1d8+3) or +11 (4d8+3)
Special Attacks deeds (deadeye, gunslinger initiative, gunslinger’s dodge, pistol-whip, quick clear, utility shot), grit (1), gun training +3 (double-barreled shotgun, zero pistol), sneak attack +4d6

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 17, Con 14, Int 9, Wis 11, Cha 8
Base Atk +11; CMB +14; CMD 30
Feats Deadly Aim, Gunsmithing, Impact Critical Shot, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Reload (double-barreled shotgun), Rapid Shot, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (zero pistol)
Skills Acrobatics +8 (+12 to jump with a running start), Bluff +15, Climb +19, Disguise +4, Intimidate +10, Perception +12, Sense Motive +11, Stealth +24
Languages Common
SQ build points (5—natural armor (2), hidden storage compartment), rogue talents (befuddling strike, convincing lie, fast getaway, powerful sneak), trapfinding +4
Combat Gear potion of cure serious wounds, potion of displacement in compartment; Other Gear +1 chameleon suit, +1 zero pistol with extra power cell, masterwork double-barreled shotgun with 8 metal cartridges (4 bullets, 4 pellets), ring of protection +1, hefty trawlerman’s wax coat with several deep pockets, within which are a set of masterwork tools, a chaarskin wallet with 67 gp and the keys to his tenement, a small opium pipe, and a hipflask containing gin.
